name: study-detective-agency
description: Browser-based 4th grade study games, themed as detective case files.
//: The site is built with Vite: `npm run build` writes the deployable
site to dist/ with content-hashed asset filenames (that hash is what
lets _headers cache /assets/* immutable for a year). The game code
itself has no runtime dependencies -- Vite only bundles and hashes it.
jsdom is needed by test/dom.test.js. That file skips itself when jsdom
is missing, so `node --test` runs on a fresh clone without an install
and still gets the generator and helper suites.
